svg.text: CVA6 Load-Use Scoreboard Delay & Store Buffer Address Matching (Cycles 293 – 324)
Inspection of memory hazard stalls: (1) Load-Use dependency on LW 0(x1) stalling ADDI, and (2) Store-to-Load address collision where page_offset match holds LSU in WAIT_PAGE_OFFSET.

1. Load-Use Delay: Between cycles 295 and 312, instruction ADDI x12 is held in scoreboard issue (StallRaw=1, StallRs1=1) until LW 0(x1) returns data from D-cache at cycle 312. ForwardRs1 asserts at cycle 313, and ADDI executes immediately.

2. Store Buffer Hazard: Following SW 4(x1) at cycle 317, LW 4(x1) accesses the exact same byte offset. PageOffsetMatches asserts, forcing LoadUnitState into WAIT_PAGE_OFFSET (3) until the store buffer commits and drains to memory.
